title: Round 4 · v4
meta: a fourth, fresh critic · 8 fps through the climax and the hold, 24 fps at the get-up, sound by measurement
gap: Not blocking: in the final sill pose the forelegs stack over the neck and one crosses the collar, so at phone size the front end reads as a knot with an eye rather than a chin on the paws.
repair: The next cut: from 58 to 63 s no foreleg overlaps the neck or collar, the collar is one band, both front paws lie ahead of the chest and under or ahead of the chin, and at 320 px the chin visibly rests on a paw.
notes: Every part of round 3's condition holds: the neck unbroken, the collar below the shoulder line, 36% of the dog outside the jamb, the tags clear of each other.
The climax holds: the head lifts toward the lit interior at 56.4 s and holds past 57.5 s, lowers at 57.7 s and stays down to the fade.
Continuous: the person's sit, the dog getting up, the title crossfades.
Still to improve: the lifted head turns nearly frontal, so it partly reads as looking at the camera; the cycle diagram's small labels; a hiss-like ambience floor; the small red line over the title.
keep: The lineage; refusal and its consequence; the patient approach; the dog half in and half out at the jamb, which states the idea in one image; a look, then a settle, so the film does not obey; the quiet hold; the lockup.
done: Accepted. The film on the page is v4. The critic's remaining notes are the next box's first repairs, listed under Next.
